title: Escrow depositories.
bodyText: Any title insurer or insurer which operates as an escrow depository as defined in chapter 449 shall be licensed in accordance with chapter 449.
bodyHtml: [§431:20-106.5]  Escrow depositories.  Any title insurer or insurer which operates as an escrow depository as defined in chapter 449 shall be licensed in accordance with chapter 449. [L 1996, c 27, §1]
